claims: Continue lung-protective mechanical ventilation with low tidal volumes and monitor plateau pressures.
Assess and manage anemia, considering transfusion if hemoglobin remains below 7-8 g/dL.
Monitor hemodynamics closely given hypotension (MAP 63 mmHg) and consider vasopressor support as needed.
Continue sedation with dexmedetomidine/propofol targeting RASS 0 to -2 and reassess daily.
Monitor and manage pain with multimodal analgesia, reassessing pain scores regularly.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin therapy as ordered to maintain glucose control.
Continue stress ulcer prophylaxis and assess enteral feeding tolerance given NPO status.
Perform oral care with chlorhexidine and subglottic suctioning to prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia.
Monitor coagulation parameters and manage anticoagulation as indicated.
Assess readiness for weaning from mechanical ventilation and consider spontaneous breathing trial when appropriate.
